cards.ex: We won three games in a row.
By the way, did you see my message?
I haven't seen him for a while.
I can't wait to see you!
Pizza or chicken? It's up to you.

quiz.q: It rained five days ___ this week.
quiz.note: in a row = 연속으로. 전치사 in이 고정!

quiz.q: ___ , what time is the meeting tomorrow?
quiz.note: by the way = 화제 전환 '그런데'. on my way(가는 중)와 구분!

quiz.q: She lived in Busan ___ before moving to Seoul.
quiz.note: for + 기간. for a while = 한동안.

quiz.q: I ___ to start my vacation next week!
quiz.note: can't wait to + 동사 = 빨리 하고 싶어 못 참겠다!
up to you = 네 선택에 달렸어. 결정권을 넘길 때!

cards.ex: Let's make sure we're on the same page.
Long story short, we missed the flight.
It's getting late — let's hit the road.
I'm feeling a bit under the weather today.
Can I take a rain check on dinner?

quiz.q: Before we start, let's get everyone ___ .
quiz.note: on the same page = 모두 같은 그림을 보고 있다. 회의 필수 표현!

quiz.q: ___ , the deal fell through at the last minute.
quiz.note: long story short = 긴 얘기 줄이면. 요약 신호탄!

quiz.q: We should ___ before traffic gets bad.
quiz.note: hit the road = 출발하다. hit이 핵심!

quiz.q: He's ___ today, so he's working from home.
quiz.note: under the weather = 컨디션이 안 좋은. 아플 때 부드러운 표현.

quiz.q: I'm busy tonight. Can I ___ on the movie?
quiz.note: take a rain check = 다음을 기약하다. 야구 우천 교환권에서 온 말!

cards.expr: the ball is in your court
cards.ex: I made my offer — the ball is in your court.
We only meet once in a blue moon.
Speak of the devil — here he comes!
Let's cut to the chase: what's the price?

cards.expr: hit the nail on the head
cards.ex: You hit the nail on the head with that analysis.

quiz.hint: 결정권이 상대에게 넘어갔다는 테니스 코트 표현
accept: the ball is in your court
the ball is in your court.
quiz.note: 공이 상대 코트에 있다 = 다음 행동은 네 몫.

quiz.q: My uncle visits us ___ — maybe once a year.
quiz.note: blue moon = 한 달에 두 번째 뜨는 보름달. 그만큼 드물다!

quiz.q: ___ ! We were just talking about you.
quiz.hint: 호랑이도 제 말 하면 — 영어에선 악마가 옵니다
quiz.note: 누군가 얘기하던 중 그 사람이 나타났을 때!

quiz.q: We don't have much time, so let's ___ .
quiz.note: 옛 영화의 지루한 부분을 잘라내고 추격신으로 간 데서 유래.

accept: hit the nail on the head
hit the nail on the head.
quiz.note: hit-hit-hit 무변화 동사! 정확히 맞는 지적에 쓰는 최고의 칭찬.
